keyFindings.description: Round 2's change to the remote-NATS refusal (internal/bus/reach.go:48, natsURLWithoutUserinfo, 2281e62aabbc) broke three existing tests that this PR did not update: TestConnectOwningStreamRefusesANATSServerThatIsNotThisMachines, TestDialRefusesANATSServerThatIsNotThisMachines and TestConnectRefusesANATSServerThatIsNotThisMachines. Each one asserts that the refusal contains `remote`, a testnats URL that carries user:password, verbatim. They failed in envoy-go-race at dd2fb2b41ecf (run 40173085050, job 121111427588; remote_nats_test.go:56, :89, :118: `refusal "bus: refusing a NATS server that is not this machine's: nats://10.1.1.85:32771 (set ENVOY_ALLOW_REMOTE_NATS=1 to reach it)" does not name ... the server ***10.1.1.85:32771`). The production code is unchanged since then, and remote_nats_test.go is unchanged at this head, so the next envoy-go and envoy-go-race runs will fail the same way. Fix: assert that the refusal names the address without userinfo, keep the override assertion, and assert that neither the user nor the password is present. Keep the redaction.

roundTwoFindings: PRRT_kwDORFy7ds6v_jdd (the unguarded log capture) is fixed in 29ebf098c578 and accepted, with a reply on the thread.

thermo: thermonuclear-deep-review and thermonuclear-code-quality at 5cda7902: both CHANGES on the remote_nats assertions alone. Their repository-wide consumer search (packages/envoy, packages/daemon, scripts, docs, CI) found no other test or consumer that depends on the old URL rendering, the old watcher-stopped ERROR level or the health body. The round's test-helper delta is sound.
